1: # CULP: Classification Using Link Prediction
2: This is the implementation of the CULP classification algorithm from the paper ***Classification Using Link Prediction***.
3: 
4: * run `iris_sample.py` to run CULP on the Iris dataset with 80% of instances as the training data 
5: * run `zoo_sample` for the Zoo dataset with 80% of the instances being the training data.
6: * run `wine_sample` for the Wine dataset with 80% of the instances being the training data.
7: 
8: or run `run.sh` to run CULP on all the cases above.
9: 
10: *note: You can also access this on [github](https://github.com/AminFadaee/culp)*
